profile.primary_purpose: Introduce Gonzalo Silman and surface featured work
profile.brand_signature: Warm cream editorial page with expressive Inter weight contrast and a single orange accent. Minimal chrome, left-aligned content column, Maraoz-style nav and writing list, Tieshun-style section rhythm.

visual_language.accent_strategy: Orange (#E85D04) for primary CTA and link accents only; cream surfaces and espresso text carry the rest. source: user-override (not Agustín yellow).
visual_language.highlights: H1 weight split (200/600) from agustindorego.com; writing rows with date + title from maraoz.com.

target_audience: Founders and operators evaluating Gonzalo for a role or build
Investors and peers in LatAm / SF networks
strategy.executive_synthesis: Personal landing that borrows Agustín's type and cream chrome, Tieshun's bio and investment list structure, and Maraoz's nav, writing list, and footer. Palette is an intentional orange-on-cream override.

style_classification.reasoning: Master reference agustindorego.com: Inter + DM Mono, parchment cream, high type contrast, little chrome.

grid.notes: Content column from tieshunroquerre.com (56em single column) scaled to 720px; page padding 24px mobile / 40px desktop.

layout.section_separation: Vertical rhythm via section padding (64px desktop / 48px mobile) and 1px #D5CFC4 rules before Writing and Footer. notes: maraoz.com section divider #DCDCDC adapted to parchment family.

rules.description: Page and card grounds. Adapted from agustindorego.com Warm Parchment with lighter cream bias. source: user-override.
Sole accent for primary CTA and hover accents. source: user-override.

insights: Agustín walnut #4A453E and yellow are NOT used; Signal Orange replaces CTA fill. source: user-override.
Espresso #1C1814 and Ash #8C867C kept from agustindorego.com for type hierarchy.
Cream family lightened from #EDE8E0 page bias to #F7F1E8 for a cleaner cream read.

typography.highlights: H1 weight contrast (200 vs 600) from agustindorego.com. No em dashes in copy.
insights: Inter + DM Mono pair from agustindorego.com is the master type stack.
Mono labels are uppercase with letter-spacing 0.08em for CTA and nav.

surfaces.notes: Flat cream page; project cards use Card Cream #FFFBF5 with 1px #D5CFC4 border and 12px radius (softer than Agustín 20px bento to fit long-form).

elevation.notes: No heavy shadows; optional soft card shadow 0 1px 2px rgba(28,24,20,0.06).

interactions.reduced_motion: No entrance choreography; honor prefers-reduced-motion by keeping transitions at 0.

top_nav.description: Sticky top row: name left, anchor links right. Dot separators between anchors from maraoz.com. No meeting CTA.

data_display.notes: Project cards: title, one-liner, tag mono, optional OG image. Writing: date mono uppercase, title link. Investments: name link + one line.

icons.notes: Text labels for socials in footer (X, LinkedIn, Email) like Agustín footer links; no icon font required.
